:rocket: New: Product Feedback Form is Live
We've set up a structured way to submit product feedback, feature requests, and improvement ideas.
How it works:
1. Click the green "Give Product Feedback" button at the bottom of this channel
2. Fill in the short form — title, description, type, priority, client name, and attach any screenshots or recordings
3. Hit submit. A structured summary gets posted here and an Asana task is auto-created in the Product Backlog

Why this matters:
• Every piece of feedback now gets tracked, prioritised, and triaged — nothing falls through the cracks
• Attachments (screenshots, Loom recordings) are captured in the form itself
• Priority definitions are built into the form so we're all speaking the same language on urgency
• Date, reporter, and client name are captured automatically for better prioritisation

What changes for you: Use the button for all product feedback going forward.

:rotating_light: Important: All product feedback must go through the form from now on. Freeform messages in this channel will not be triaged. If it's not in the form, it's not in the backlog.
